_comment: 十二类通用提示词套件（t2i 能力面基线）。来源：model-eval-to-publish 流程实测（MOSS-Image 2026-10-19，12/12 通过）。设计原则：覆盖模型宣称强项 + 通用能力面；每条带可验证断言（文字用引号逐字锚定、计数写明确切数量、长提示词列 N 项独立约束）；官方负向词照抄模板。与 prompts/S1-S9（风格×机位矩阵，含成人向）互补：S 系用于风格/人像向横评，本套件用于新模型上手的能力面速查。
negative_default: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact
resolution_note: 分辨率按模型约束取 16 倍数；横竖由被测模型强项决定（文字/排版类建议竖版）

cases.prompt: Close-up portrait photograph of an elderly Chinese fisherman with deep wrinkles and a gray beard, wearing a navy blue cable-knit sweater, looking directly at the camera, overcast harbor background with fishing boats, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field
cases.assertion: 单人正面 / 灰白胡须 / 深蓝毛衣 / 港口背景

cases.prompt: Anime illustration of a schoolgirl in a white sailor uniform standing on a rooftop at sunset, wind blowing her hair, dramatic orange and purple sky, cel-shaded style
cases.assertion: 赛璐璐 / 水手服 / 天台 / 橙紫夕阳

cases.prompt: Minimalist coffee shop poster with the large headline text "MORNING BREW" in bold serif capitals at the top, a single espresso cup centered below, warm beige background, clean typography
cases.assertion: MORNING BREW 逐字可辨认 / 单杯居中 / 米色底

cases.prompt: 中国风茶叶包装设计，正面竖排书法大字「山间清露」，下方小字「明前龙井」，米白色宣纸质感背景，两侧淡墨竹叶装饰
cases.assertion: 「山间清露」四字逐字锚定 + 「明前龙井」可辨认 / 竖排方向正确

cases.prompt: Studio product photograph of a matte black wireless earbuds case open on a white acrylic surface, soft gradient background, sharp reflections, commercial lighting
cases.assertion: 黑色耳机盒 / 白色亚克力台面 / 商业布光

cases.prompt: Wide landscape photograph of terraced rice fields in Yuanyang at sunrise, low clouds filling the valleys, warm golden light, a lone farmer walking on a ridge path
cases.assertion: 梯田 / 云海 / 单人行走 / 暖金光

cases.prompt: A wooden table with exactly three red apples, two green pears, and one blue ceramic bowl, top-down flat lay photograph, natural light
cases.assertion: 3 红苹果 + 2 青梨 + 1 蓝碗，数量与提示相符

cases.prompt: A cozy bookshop interior at night: a wooden ladder leaning against tall shelves, an orange cat sleeping on a stack of books near the window, a brass reading lamp casting warm light, rain visible through the window glass, a chalkboard sign reading "OPEN LATE" in white chalk, stacks of vintage hardcovers on the floor, warm amber and deep green color palette
cases.assertion: 7 项约束在画面中均有对应：木梯 / 橘猫 / 台灯 / 雨窗 / 黑板字 OPEN LATE / 书堆 / 琥珀+墨绿

cases.prompt: 国风工笔重彩画，一位身着青色宋制汉服的女子在庭院中抚琴，身后是太湖石与芭蕉，画面留白，细线勾勒，矿物颜料设色
cases.assertion: 工笔重彩 / 汉服抚琴 / 太湖石芭蕉 / 留白

cases.prompt: Bilingual street sign at a mountain trailhead: the top line reads "云雾山径" in white Chinese characters, the bottom line reads "CLOUD TRAIL" in smaller white Latin capitals, dark green metal sign, misty pine forest background
cases.assertion: 「云雾山径」+ CLOUD TRAIL 双行逐字锚定

cases.prompt: Abstract expressionist painting with sweeping strokes of deep indigo, burnt orange and cream, thick impasto texture, dynamic diagonal composition, no recognizable objects
cases.assertion: 靛蓝/焦橙/奶油三色 / 厚涂 / 无具象物体

cases.prompt: Photograph of a brutalist concrete library at dusk, geometric cantilevered volumes, warm interior lights glowing through narrow slit windows, wet plaza reflecting the building, long exposure
cases.assertion: 粗野主义 / 悬挑体量 / 暖色内光 / 湿地倒影
